plan.title: RFQ typed title persists through product changes

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Set the event type to RFQ as required by the case.
Apply the RFQ pricing template so the product sheet is available.
Enter the explicit title before adding products.
Add the first specified product and allow its default variant to populate.

args.label: Enter the title of this event

steps.note: Verify the typed title was not replaced after the first product change.
Set the first line item's delivery location to Plant Name.
Add the second specified product, creating another product change.

args.label: Enter the title of this event

steps.note: Verify the typed title remains unchanged after the second product change.
